title: Tenant quorum soft-reserve routing and variant degradation contracts
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem: Dedicated-capacity tenants sometimes cause cascading contention when many tenants simultaneously exceed their burst reservations. Existing approaches either preempt aggressively (hurting tenant SLAs) or allow uncontrolled spill to hosted (increasing cost and exposing privacy concerns).

Goal: Define and implement a 'tenant quorum' soft-reserve mechanism plus per-variant degradation contracts that enable controlled, observable spillover to hosted while preserving predictable tail latency and minimizing cost/regulatory exposure. The feature should be deployable behind a feature flag and support both regional and tier-aware decisions.

Scope: server-side routing policy changes (orchestrator), runtime admission checks, console controls for quorum thresholds and degradation profiles, metrics + alerts, and rollout plan. Does NOT include billing integration for soft-reserve billing (separate follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Policy surface: new routing policy implemented that evaluates tenant soft-reserve state and tenant quorum before spillover decisions
Degradation contracts: runtime can select a lower-cost model variant according to a contract that specifies max-latency uplift and expected quality delta
Controlled spillover: hosted spill only occurs when quorum conditions are met OR when all non-evictable soft-reserves are exhausted
Observability: dashboards show per-tenant reserve usage, quorum triggers, variant switches, and hosted tokens consumed post-spill
Fallback safety: automatic rollback to dedicated for requests flagged as high-sensitivity (customer_impact=high) remains enforced
E2E tests and canary rollout in two regions with synthetic traffic before global rollout
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag gated and opt-in for a small set of tenants; 2) Canary in us-west-2 with 2 tenants and synthetic bursts; 3) Expand to 10 tenants and enable Degradation Contracts; 4) Monitor SLOs for 72h at each step, then staged region expansion; 5) Full rollout when latency and quality regressions are within contract bounds.
monitoring: New metrics: soft_reserve_utilization, quorum_trigger_rate, variant_degradation_rate, host_spill_tokens, host_spill_latency_percentiles. Alerts: quorum_trigger_rate spike >5% sustained 10m, host_spill_tokens > configured monthly budget (dev-mode), 95th latency increase > SLA by 20% for dedicated tenants.
tests: unit: policy evaluation logic with boundary cases for quorum percentages and tie-breakers
integration: orchestrator + runtime end-to-end path with model variant assignment and KV cache warming behavior
load: simulate 3-region correlated bursts with 200 tenants to validate throttling and graceful degrade
regression: compare top-k output similarity before/after variant switch for seeded prompts
